source_title: ‘HE'S PUKING ALL OVER!’: Trump Mocks James Talarico As ‘Vegan’, Jokes About Forced Meat-Eating
source_excerpt: US President Donald Trump mocked Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico during a rally in South Carolina, repeatedly calling him a vegan and claiming he opposed meat, oil and guns. Trump joked that Talarico had begun attending barbecues for political reasons, making exaggerated remarks about being forced to eat meat and vomiting backstage. He also predicted that Talarico would return to his supposed vegan lifestyle after the election, regardless of the result. The remarks were part of Trump's broader criticism of Democratic candidates ahead of the midterms. The claims about Talarico's diet and positions were Trump's assertions, not independently established facts.
